annotations.title: Everything needed to apply for a job

description: Everything needed to apply for a job. For "help me apply for this", "write my cover letter", "what should I say in my application?". Gives what the job asks for, the lines in the CV that prove each skill, what is missing, keywords to use if true, a cover letter outline and common application questions with how to answer them, so a tailored letter and answers can be written. Job Spotter never applies or sends anything. Nothing sent is stored.

cv.description: The CV as plain text. Optional if titles and skills are given.

employers.description: Current and past employers, comma separated.

id.description: A job id from a search result, copied exactly. Or give job_text.

job_text.description: The job advert as plain text, when there is no id.

location.description: Where the person lives or wants to work.

titles.description: Current and past job titles, comma separated.

name: apply_kit
title: Everything needed to apply for a job
